[!cgo] skip

go build -o $WORK/pkg-config$GOEXE ./pkgconfig
env PKG_CONFIG=$WORK/pkg-config$GOEXE
go build ./p

-- go.mod --
module example

go 1.27
-- pkgconfig/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	for _, arg := range os.Args {
		if arg == "--define-variable=A=b-c" {
			return
		}
	}
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "missing --define-variable argument")
	os.Exit(1)
}
-- p/p.go --
package p

// #cgo pkg-config: --define-variable=A=b-c example
import "C"
